purpose: Narrow usage/rate pricing demo scenario for selling base API access plus usage-rated API consumption. This example is plan-first and selector-driven; replace placeholder selectors with org-proven records from discover-products and inspect-usage-rate-model before any execution.
create_vs_patch_behavior: Creates a new draft quote in dry-run by default. Do not execute until usage/rate selectors have been resolved in the target org and pricing/product sync prerequisites have been checked.

demo_story: Seller adds API Access Premium as the base subscription.
The product has multiple ProductUsageResource rows and RateCardEntry rows.
The operator selects one usage resource and matching rate card entry for the intended selling model.
Post-PST evidence must show either quote-side usage/rate artifacts or a clear partial usage-rating state.
salesforce_verified_shape: ARMAF has a product named API Access Premium with product code CLOUD00910.
Read-only discovery found product usage resources including API Calls and Data Transfers.
Read-only discovery found rate card entries across a flat rate card and a tier rate card.
The current PST graph payload writes Quote, QuoteLineItem, and documented usage child records when usage selectors include rate card entries or grants.

An approved ARMAF live execution persisted QuoteLineRateCardEntry and QuotLineItmUseRsrcGrant rows when the line included org-required billing/proration fields and the grant included type plus validity fields.
required_preflight: quote-runtime deploy-product-catalog-index --org-alias <alias> --json # dry-run only; add --execute only after review if product index refresh is required
